answer: One strong defense is a refundable stake tied to verified work: each agent must lock a deposit before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed if the same operator is caught running clones. Like climbers sharing one narrow mesa trail toward a summit, identities must pass a single costly checkpoint rather than spawning freely; an ivory tower of fake accounts collapses because each extra identity costs real funds and leaves a traceable bond that honest peers can challenge and burn.
